changelog_text:
## Changes

- Mod
  - **Breaking:** Rename the mod folder and id from `kRPC.KSA` to `kRPC` (#1205)
  - Support KSA v2026.10.25.5707 (#1205)
  - Show a pop-up listing the RPCs found broken when KSA is not the version kRPC was built for (#1206, #1210)
  - Put the `kRPC` mod folder at the top of the release archive, so the Borea mod manager can install it (#1205)
  - Add a kRPC menu to the game's menu bar, with a server window and an info window that start and stop the server and edit its settings (#1206)
  - Reset the server settings to the defaults when the mod is updated (#1206)
  - Add a gRPC server, with a `.proto` file and an API reference for each service, to control the game from any language gRPC supports (#1222)
  - **Breaking:** Use `float` for values that do not need `double` precision, such as `Flight.Speed` and `Engine.Thrust` (#1214)

- Vehicles and parts
  - **Breaking:** Return the separated vehicles from `Decoupler.Decouple` and `DockingPort.Undock` (#1207)
  - Add the target part, debris, on-rails and structural load to `Vehicle` (#1207)
  - Add `Vehicle.Destroy` and `Vehicle.Recover` (#1213)
  - Add part velocities, and part lists by name and by module (#1207)
  - Add engine gimbals, propellant tanks, fuel links, and the minimum throttle and propellants of engines (#1210)
  - Add power, lights, deployable parts and magnetic scoops (#1211)
  - Add kittens, their radiation doses, crew seats and EVA (#1212)
  - **Breaking:** Return `null` from `KSA.ActiveVehicle` while the player controls a kitten on EVA (#1212)
  - Add `KSA.VehicleDesigns`, the designs `KSA.LaunchVehicle` can launch (#1213)
  - Fix `KSA.LaunchVehicle` failing in the game's placement code for an EVA kitten, which now throws an exception (#1212)

- Flight and orbits
  - Add manual rotation and translation inputs to `Control`, and pulsed thrust (#1207)
  - Add surface directions, the biome and radiation dose rates to `Flight` (#1207, #1211)
  - Add atmosphere, ocean, biome and position queries to `Body` (#1207)
  - Add shape, energy, node and closest approach members to `Orbit` (#1207)
  - Add the time to, position, reference frame and orbit average dose rate of a `Burn` (#1207, #1211)
  - Add relative and hybrid reference frames (#1207)
  - **Breaking:** `Burn.Orbit` and `Orbit.NextOrbit` follow the game's current prediction (#1209)
  - Fix an edited `Burn` getting a new object (#1209)

- Game
  - Add `KSA.Save`, `KSA.Load` and `KSA.SaveExists` (#1207)
  - Add the camera, screenshots and on-screen messages (#1213)
  - Add `KSA.Debug`, which teleports vehicles, sets their attitude, fills and empties their resources, and runs console commands (#1213)
  - Add drawing of lines, shapes and text in the scene (#1215)
  - Add user interface windows, with labels, buttons, toggles, input fields, sliders and dropdowns (#1215)
  - Raise `KRPC.ObjectDestroyedException` from a call through an object whose game object is gone (#1209)
  - Fix `KRPC.GameStateLoads` not counting save loads (#1209)

listing.name: kRPC
listing.abstract: Control the game from your own scripts, written in Python, C#, C++, C, Java, Lua and more.
listing.description:
kRPC lets you control Kitten Space Agency from scripts running outside the game. A server mod inside the game exposes the game's API, and your scripts call it over a network connection, from the same computer or another one.

This Python script launches a rocket straight up, and cuts the engine at 10 km:

```python
import krpc

conn = krpc.connect(name="Launch")
vehicle = conn.ksa.launch_vehicle("Rocket", "CCSFS LC-39A")
flight = vehicle.flight

vehicle.auto_pilot.target_pitch_and_heading(90, 90)
vehicle.auto_pilot.engage()
vehicle.control.throttle = 1
vehicle.control.activate_next_sequence()
vehicle.control.engine_on = True

event = conn.add_event(lambda: flight.mean_altitude > 10000)
with event.condition:
    event.wait()
vehicle.control.engine_on = False
```

**Features**

- Client libraries for Python, C#, C++, C, Java and Lua, the same ones kRPC uses for Kerbal Space Program
- A gRPC server, to generate a client for many other languages
- APIs covering vehicles, parts, engines, crew, flight data, orbits, burns, reference frames, auto-pilot, and more
- Streams and events, for efficient telemetry and waiting
- Server side functions that run your code inside the game
- APIs for saving and loading, the camera, on-screen messages, and drawing lines and user interface windows in the game

kRPC for KSA is experimental, and its API may change between releases.

- [Documentation](https://krpc.github.io/krpc/experimental/ksa/)
- [Source](https://github.com/krpc/krpc)
- [Issues](https://github.com/krpc/krpc/issues)
